common_flow: Open the site and search for the user query.
On results, identify job cards by company and position.
If selecting a result opens a side panel, collect visible detail or navigate to the canonical detail page when available.
Scroll through the detail body and collect requirement and benefit sections.
Return to results and continue with the next unvisited card.

collection_policy.finish_condition: Requested trend sample size is reached or no unvisited cards remain.

known_pitfalls: Some URLs represent a listing with selectedJobId rather than a dedicated detail page.
Card text order can matter; preserve both company and job title as semantic identity.
